scenario_name: The count of a product's units is the sum over its bins
No count is given when a product's units add up to more than the maximum
The bin found is the first one that holds enough of the product
Nothing is found when no bin holds enough of the product
Every bin of the product gains the amount, up to the maximum
Restocking reports how many bins it restocked
The amount taken is what was asked for, or all there is if that is less
The product's units go down by exactly the amount taken
Units are taken from the earliest bins of the product first
The number of orders filled is the number that can be covered in full when their turn comes
What is left is what remains after filling, in turn, the orders that can be covered
No more orders are filled than were given
The count is the number of different products
There are no more products than bins
A product in more than half of the bins is the dominant product
There is no dominant product when no product is in more than half of the bins
